title: Orbit Stack
licenseSummary: All code, procedural vector geometry, and WebAudio synthesizer patches are 100% self-authored original works released under MIT / CC0.

assets.description: Dynamic N-gon (6, 7, 8 sides) radial vector core, lane guide rails, trapezoidal shard blocks with colorblind-accessible geometric glyphs (▲, ●, ■, ◆, ★), landing ghost previews, and radial containment ring.
60fps radial shard burst particles, Phase Pulse shockwave rings, and floating combo score popups.
Zero-dependency WebAudio synthesizer producing crisp rotation ticks, bass lock thuds, pentatonic ascending match arpeggios, polygon morph fanfare, and phase pulse sweeps.
